DARV.talk.SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_CHARACTER_SUN: This looks like a warehouse after the sets have been struck. Props are piled everywhere… I recognize some of them. I've worn them.

Gentlemen, forgive the mess. These were all left behind when the set was struck. See that axe? Pan Feng used it, and it took a few bouts with Hua Xiong before it hit the ground. Pick whatever suits your hand.
Extra, you've come again. Last time you were a gatekeeper; this call sheet says you're Lord Guan now. Blink once, and an old hen turns into a duck!
I've searched everywhere and found no prop proving that "you are you." A handful of extras play hundreds of roles—who can remember who is who?
…If such a thing existed, it wouldn't be displayed at the warehouse entrance. Extras' things are kept in the corners, like servants beside their masters—unremembered.
Well said. Take it with you. If you botch the next scene and the stagehands throw you out, at least the prop will still be in your hands.
NEOW.talk.SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_CHARACTER_SUN: No sets, no cameras… A narrator speaks over the empty stage: "The Three Kingdoms are united once more…" Wait. What does "once more" mean?

[sine]...That's Lord Destiny..... 
...the director went in..... 
...the screenwriter went in too..... 
...only the narrator remains..... 
...still reciting..... 
...history has changed.....[/sine]

[sine]...you've started filming again..... 
...this take..... 
...doesn't match the last..... 
...like a revised dub..... 
...voice change.....[/sine]

[sine]...what do you still lack..... 
...lines? storyboards?..... 
...or an ending?.....[/sine]
If you insist on writing me into the script… let me tell which memories belong to the actor, and which to the role.

[sine]...someone writes endings at the top of the Spire..... 
...go..... 
...don't trust the narrator..... 
...it only cares for upheaval..... 
...not actors.....[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_CHARACTE: Masks cover every wall… It feels as though every face I've played has been kept here.
Speak my name, and you'll be terrified! …Just kidding. I'm the makeup artist. Come, let's make you look most like the lead for today's scene.
In New Three Kingdoms, general titles are handed out wholesale, but you need a face sturdy enough to carry one—which face are you wearing today?
Extra, tell me your "true" face. The world mistook you today; it may mistake you again tomorrow.
…I have no face of my own. Only borrowed features—perhaps Sun Qian plays the entire show, changing masks and nothing more.
Then take a few borrowed faces with you. They will fight to speak for you in the next scene—I'm Zi Jing, and this makeup is making my head spin!
OROBAS.talk.SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_CHARACTER_S: The call sheet changed again… On the last page I was a messenger, on this one a eunuch, and on the next they'll have me tending the Chancellor's horses and chamber pots.
Extra, one moment you're a grand general, the next a little eunuch—this is Destiny!!
—Fine then! If he crosses the river, I cross the river; if Destiny wants to stuff me into the cycle too, I'll give it a little surprise!!
I've got something for you!! Want to seize that instant before the script turns the page?!!
…I only want a line in the script that won't rewrite itself.
There is no such thing!! But chaos has its virtues—one day, you may find a way out of the cycle!!
PAEL.talk.SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_CHARACTER_SUN: The script supervisor hasn't called "CUT," but the director is already filming the next take… An extra lies down, and their fate is unknown.
[thinky_dots]Fate unknown? That means dead… On a set, having no scene to film is no different from dying…[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]The awake memorize lines… the fallen await the script supervisor… the more corpses you play, the finer your self-decapitation becomes…[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]So… after climbing the Spire all your life, can't you just enjoy yourself for once…[/thinky_dots]
They all have names, endings, at least gravestones… But an extra must keep performing…
[thinky_dots]True… Take this, then… Before the next scene starts… you can still enjoy a cool summer night…[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_CHARACTER_SUN: They want a fight scene without rehearsal… The call sheet only says "fight," not even who my opponent is.
[b]Enough talk!! My great axe has been thirsty for battle!! You! Grab a weapon and get over here!![/b]
[b]Where's the lead?! Why isn't the one earning the outrageous salary here yet?! Stop making extras carry the fight scenes![/b]
[b]Destiny wants everyone Plated!! It wants jump cuts!! It doesn't want acting!! Then we'll act for it!![/b]
…I've never trained in martial arts. Yet my body remembers how to swing a blade…
[b]Fine!! Then fight upward!! Fight to the top of the Spire!! Stab ten thousand transparent holes through it!!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_CHARACTE: The fire is warm enough… But the crew has wrapped for the day, the Chenliu cafeteria is closed, and they didn't even leave a box lunch.
Extra, no food is no trouble. Here, have some [jitter][b]hot wine[/b][/jitter] first—bottoms up! What to eat? Wine is enough.
That pile on your back isn't luggage, is it? It's scripts you haven't unloaded. Want to set down one face here first? I'm thirsty—sit with me awhile.
Have a bite while it's hot. Exquisite beyond compare—will you take some with you? Don't let it go cold midway.
…No need. An extra being a little hungry is normal—no one remembers whether they gave you a meal.
Then sit by the fire awhile. …When it goes out, continue your journey by starlight.
VAKUU.talk.SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_CHARACTER_SU: You trade too? Then what will you exchange… your name, your memories, or the words "Supporting Actor"?
The cheapest thing is that bit of [sine]self[/sine] you think still belongs to you. You know, I run an honest business—every clause is written clearly in the contract.
I've seen plenty who sell their souls. You, though, seem to understand me without a word.
There's a line of fine print at the end: "Party B agrees to permanently play any role assigned by another." Sign?
Anything… In the end, everything is Destiny.
Good resolve!! May you discern which debt must be paid by which "you."
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_CHAR: Your call sheet never sent you here.
Call what? Sheet what? Never heard of it!
At the top of this Spire, who's in charge—you, or me?
Back again. Are you here for a reshoot, or another performance?
Do not be angry. Anger lowers your intelligence.
Corrupted like this, and you still made it here…?

After an extra has played every role…
[i][font_size=22]will what remains be me?[/font_size][/i]
An extra? But the dragon is the sign of an emperor…
